# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class FutureContractExampleAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2024, 9, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        # Set the data normalization mode as backwards_ratio for daily SPX future data
        self.set_data_normalization_mode(FutureDataNormalizationMode.BACKWARDS_RATIO)
        # Set the data mapping mode as last_trading_day for daily SPX future data
        self.set_data_mapping_mode(ContinuousMappingMode.LAST_TRADING_DAY)
        # Set the filter mode as extended_market_hours for extended market hours SPX future data
        self.set_filter_mode(FilterMode.EXTENDED_market_HOURS)

        self._future = self.add_future(Futures.Indices.SP_500_E_MINI, mapping_mode=ContinuousMappingMode.LAST_TRADING_DAY, normalization_mode=FutureDataNormalizationMode.BACKWARDS_RATIO, filter_end_date_offset=92, filter_start_date_offset=0)
        # Alternatively, use the convenience method.
        # self._future = self.add_future(Futures.Indices.SP_500_E_MINI)
        # Set the contract management mode as rolling for automatic contract rollover
        self._future.set_contract_management_mode(ContractManagementMode.ROLLING)

    def on_data(self, slice: Slice) -> None:
        if not self._future.is_ready:
            return
        # Only trade if the contract is ready
        price = self._future.price
        if price > 4000:
            self.market_order(self._future, 1)
        elif price < 4000:
            self.market_order(self._future, -1)

    def on_contract_changed(self, changed_contract: FutureContract) -> None:
        if changed_contract.is_new:
            self.liquidate(self._future, tag=f"Liquidated {self._future.symbol} on contract change")
